Start with the quantity you need. Each goal links to a complete notebook path, with separate solver tabs where SCGSim has both backends.

## Choose a calculation {#getting-started}

| Goal | Workflow | Returned quantity |
|---|---|---|
| Capacitance | [Palace Electrostatic or AEDT Q3D](tutorials/capacitance.qmd) | Labeled conductor capacitance matrix |
| Resonant modes | [Palace or HFSS Eigenmode](tutorials/resonance.qmd) | Mode frequencies and returned mode report |
| Energy participation | [Palace or HFSS EPR](tutorials/resonance-epr.qmd) | Surface, bulk and branch participation by mode |
| Driven S-parameters | [HFSS Modal or Terminal](tutorials/scattering.qmd) | Two-port response with the selected port family |
| Transmission-line parameters | [AEDT Q2D](tutorials/transmission-line.qmd) | Per-length C, G, L and R matrices |

## Prepare, execute, then read the return

Begin with [installation](course/installation.qmd), then follow the selected workflow's input, preparation and result-reading steps. The [model and materials reference](reference.qmd#model-materials) and [conductors and ports reference](reference.qmd#conductors-ports) explain the choices that determine the physical model. If you already have a returned package, start at [returned results](course/returned-results.qmd).

## Public component source and version pairing {#public-inputs}

The Xmon documentation uses this exact public package pair. The OrPen entry is a public, independently parameterized adaptation; its defaults are not a paper mask or measured device. The source map records the package revisions and component metadata used here. It does not establish that the historical upstream notebook runs unchanged or report an installation, preparation, or solve.

| Role | Version and source |
|---|---|
| SCGSim source/API baseline | `2.0.0rc15`, commit [`0f6b4e5c54aff4891492976a5dd58387cc1a1787`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/scgsim/tree/0f6b4e5c54aff4891492976a5dd58387cc1a1787) |
| OrPen SC PDK | `0.1.0.dev2`, commit [`03b1bc783ba0372ba0df1a765aa5ee446b182080`](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/tree/03b1bc783ba0372ba0df1a765aa5ee446b182080) |
| Documentation bundle | SCGSim `2.0.0rc16`, bundle manifest schema `1.0` |
| Historical canonical OrPen lesson | [Kosen2024 Xmon Palace Route B QMD](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/blob/03b1bc783ba0372ba0df1a765aa5ee446b182080/notebooks/src/ComponentSimulation/Kosen2024_Xmon/palace_route_b_eigenmode.qmd) (source reference; not a promise that its older SCGSim calls run unchanged) |

The installation commands reconstruct the `0f6b4e5c` API-baseline pair; they do not imply that `2.0.0rc15` contains this `2.0.0rc16` documentation bundle. To record an installed bundle, read its package version and `bundle_id` from MCP `list_packages()` or from `importlib.metadata` and the installed bundle manifest; this needs no SCGSim import. Older CPW and Circular Pad notebooks remain tied to their own historical source revisions; do not mix their code and lockfiles with this Xmon pair.
